NSE revises pre-open and derivatives trading rules

The National Stock Exchange (NSE) has revised its rules for the pre-open session and derivatives trading. The changes aim to separate order collection from matching and price discovery. Under the new framework, market orders will be given priority. Traders will encounter distinct windows for placing market and limit orders during the pre-open session. These revisions are intended to streamline trading mechanisms.
